<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="58cA7xexdre4Gz58YzqO"> <mxGraphModel dx="933" dy="803" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 classDef startEnd fill:#cfd8dc,stroke:#37474f,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef action fill:#bbdefb,stroke:#1976d2,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef decision fill:#fff9c4,stroke:#fbc02d,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef failure fill:#ffcdd2,stroke:#d32f2f,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef success fill:#c8e6c9,stroke:#388e3c,stroke-width:2px;

 subgraph Enrollment[\"Worker Biometric Enrollment (One-Time)\"]
 E1([Start Enrollment]):::startEnd --> E2[Capture Facial Samples under Varying Conditions]:::action
 E2 --> E3[Generate Numerical Face Embedding on Device]:::action
 E3 --> E4[Link Face Embedding to Worker Identifier]:::action
 E4 --> E5[Discard Raw Facial Enrollment Photographs]:::action
 E5 --> E6([Enrollment Complete]):::startEnd
 end

 subgraph Attendance[\"Attendance Check-In / Check-Out Verification Flow\"]
 A1([Worker Initiates Attendance Event]):::startEnd --> A2[Obtain Device GPS Location & Target Site Assignment]:::action
 A2 --> D1{Inside Assigned Active Site Geofence?}:::decision

 D1 -- No --> F1[Reject: Worker Outside Geofence]:::failure
 D1 -- Yes --> D2{OS Mock-Location Provider Detected?}:::decision

 D2 -- Yes --> F2[Reject: Flag Event as Suspicious Fraud]:::failure
 D2 -- No --> A3[Prompt Worker for Active Liveness Challenge]:::action

 A3 --> D3{Liveness Action Passed?}:::decision
 D3 -- No --> F3[Reject: Liveness Challenge Failed]:::failure

 D3 -- Yes --> A4[Capture Live Face & Generate Live Embedding]:::action
 A4 --> A5[Compare Live Embedding with Enrolled Reference Embedding]:::action
 A5 --> D4{Similarity Score >= Threshold?}:::decision

 D4 -- No --> F4[Reject: Face Match Failed]:::failure
 D4 -- Yes --> A6[Accept Verified Attendance Event]:::success

 A6 --> D5{Event Type?}:::decision
 D5 -- Check-In --> A7[Record Verified Check-In with GPS, Timestamp, Site ID & Verification Context]:::action
 D5 -- Check-Out --> A8[Record Verified Check-Out & Link to Previous Verified Check-In]:::action

 A8 --> A9[Calculate Measured Interval Worked Hours]:::action
 A9 --> A10[Derive Overtime against Configured Site Shift Schedule]:::action

 A7 --> A11[Write Complete Record to Local Device Storage Immediately]:::action
 A10 --> A11
 A11 --> A12[Queue Event for Automatic Synchronization Engine]:::action
 A12 --> A13([Attendance Flow Complete]):::startEnd

 F1 --> F5[Display Failure Category Message to Worker]:::failure
 F2 --> F5
 F3 --> F5
 F4 --> F5
 F5 --> A14([Event Terminated - No Verified Event Constructed]):::startEnd
 end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
